text:
Your website's design matters least when Google ranks you.

Google's "How Search works" page lists five things. Looks fall under usability.

Google says usability counts when everything else is roughly equal.

A tie-breaker. That's the job your AUD$8,000 redesign does.

Try this tonight.

Open your homepage on your phone. Count how many times it says what you sell plus your suburb.

"Brake repairs Osborne Park." "Dentist Subiaco."

Google says the most basic signal is the words of the search showing up on your page.

Count zero? Fix that first.

Panel beater in Midland asks me:
"We spend AUD$3,000 a month on Google Ads. That must help our ranking?"

No.

Google says buying ads has no influence on the free results.

The ads buy the spot at the top. The free results underneath you earn separately.
